answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to file a witnessed identity affidavit before a licensed notary outside the farm, who watches the operator sign, stamps it with an umber seal, and logs it in a public record. The rules stand like timber posts — rigid, unmovable. The procedure is a fixed sonnet: one appearance, one notary, one day, never rushed. Each notary witnesses at most one farm-linked affidavit per day, and the filing fee doubles per affidavit on the same funding trail, so every extra fake costs another notary, another appearance, and twice the prior fee.
